officialEvidence.finding: Partner networks operated by Bouygues Energies & Services define their own charging tariffs. Alize subscribers receive the public charging tariff on those partner networks without an additional roaming fee, except the stated Reveo 2025 exception. Other-network prices are station-specific and exposed through the Alize app/map.
Alize Liberte is the access/mobility offer. The badge costs 12 EUR once and 0 EUR/month, and provides access to many distinct public, parking and national-operator networks.
Alize Toulouse publishes its own local public and preferential tariff grids, demonstrating that a local Alize-operated network cannot be used as the national Alize Liberte price.

nextStep: Inventory every canonical alize-liberte PDC by territory, physical operator, station identifier family and power class, then map only territories with an explicit current local tariff source.
